news.headline: Why Zscaler Stock Had Its Worst Day in 4 Months
news.summary: Shares of  Zscaler  fell Friday in their their worst daily performance in four months after the cybersecurity company made a change to its executive management.  The company said Thursday that Ross Tackett would be taking over the role of chief revenue officer from Mike Rich.  Rich is leaving Zscaler for “personal reasons,” according to the company.
